value.rationale: For the natural and widely used exponential (Matérn-1/2) covariance prior, the exact best finite sample points are not a uniform grid: two nonzero terminal margins differ systematically from interior gaps. The theorem gives a one-equation computable global optimum, a rigorous benchmark for independent stratification with a 50% asymptotic variance penalty, and an exact fluctuation coefficient. This is motivated optimal quadrature design, not an arbitrary parametric slice; it is limited to known hyperparameters, noiseless scalar one-dimensional models.
